g.text: Virtual machines, containers, and what each duplicates
App A | App B | App C
Guest OS | Guest OS | Guest OS
App A | App B | App C
overhead GBs of RAM per guest
Containers are not a security boundary in the way VMs are
namespaces limit what it can SEE
cgroups limit what it can USE
A kernel exploit escapes both. Multi-tenant clouds still run VMs underneath.
